changes_made.explanation: Normalized dataset and model names to standard capitalization. Removed duplicate variants and consolidated outputs into one clear description.
Consolidated ROUGE variants into single ROUGE metric as per simplification rule. Kept novel n-grams as separate metric since it's distinct from ROUGE.
Paper does not use LLMs as judges. Removed placeholder 'None' values.

guideline: Score fact coverage using 4-point scale (75-100%, 50-75%, 25-50%, <25% facts)
Judges score fact coverage using a 4‑point scale (75‑100% facts, 50‑75% facts, 25‑50% facts, <25% facts) and rank system outputs from 1 to 3 based on overall quality.
Higher rank score means better generation quality.

changes_made.explanation: Consolidated and clarified guidelines. Removed criteria that were not explicitly mentioned in the paper (fluency, coherence, content correctness were not explicitly listed).

overall_notes: The paper focuses on introducing and evaluating a new multi-document summarization dataset (Multi-XScience) rather than proposing new NLG models. The extraction was generally accurate but contained some duplicates and over-specification of criteria not explicitly mentioned. The paper clearly addresses NLG (multi-document summarization) and uses both automatic metrics (ROUGE, novel n-grams) and human evaluation.
